THE DESTINATION

About Jibhi Tirthan Valley

Tirthan Valley is a serene and picturesque destination located in the Kullu district of Himachal Pradesh. Nestled in the Great Himalayan National Park (GHNP), this valley is named after the crystal-clear Tirthan River that flows through it. Known for its untouched beauty, lush greenery, and tranquil atmosphere, it's a perfect getaway for nature lovers, trekkers, and peace seekers.

The valley offers scenic hiking trails, trout fishing spots, and charming villages like Gushaini and Jibhi that reflect Himachali culture. Popular activities include river crossing, waterfall treks, camping by the riverside, and exploring GHNP, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

Major Trip Highlights

Explore the untouched charm of Jibhi — a village still relatively unexplored by tourists.

Jibhi Waterfall & Mini Thailand — the magical spot that gives the valley its nickname.

Trek via Jalori Pass — to Serolsar Lake or Raghupur Fort through Himalayan flora.

Choie Waterfall — a hidden gem tucked away in Tirthan Valley.

Cozy bonfire nights — with music, under the mountain sky.

Scenic stay amidst the mountains — a genuine escape from the everyday.

Make new friends — and collect endless memories along the way.

Safe, guided travel — with experienced Trip Captains throughout.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

  • Arrival: Morning arrival in Jibhi.
  • Check-In: Hotel check-in, freshen up and relax.
  • Explore: Visit Jibhi Waterfall & explore the serene Mini Thailand.
  • Enjoy: Picturesque views and peaceful moments.
  • Evening: Return to the stay for a bonfire, light music, and dinner.
  • Overnight Stay: At hotel / camps.
  • Morning: Wake up to the mountain breeze, breakfast at the stay.
  • Drive: Drive to Jalori Pass.
  • Trek Begins: Begin trek to Serolsar Lake or Raghupur Fort (approx. 4 km).
  • En Route: Explore Himalayan flora and breathtaking vistas.
  • Return: Return to stay by evening.
  • Overnight Stay: Dinner and overnight rest.
  • Morning: Wake up & breakfast.
  • Depart: Depart for Tirthan Valley.
  • Trek: Short trek to Choie Waterfall.
  • Relax: Spend peaceful moments by the falls.
  • Departure: Depart for Delhi by evening.
  • Travel: Overnight journey back with memories to cherish.
